title: 第16章 五一相亲
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
正喝着粥。

    李西朋醒了。

    “哥，你这酒量，昨天晚上是真扛下来了啊。”

    “牛笔。”

    李西朋道：“刚哥是真能喝。”

    “关哥跟罗哥都被喝吐了。”

    “你还能坚挺，没吐。”

    “给我点碗粥来。”

    她的技师去点东西，李西朋躺在床上，丢了一支烟给李西海，自己习惯性的点上。

    粥还没喝，烟先点了的。

    “我特么怎么知道刚子发什么疯。”

    “他以为都跟他一样是个牲口啊。”

    李西海也很无奈。

    “嘿嘿。”

    李西朋笑了笑，突然笑容消失，坐直起来，举着手机，喊道：“哥，跌了。”

    “丰龙跌了。”

    李西海淡定的喝着粥，道：“跌了就跌了，慌什么。”

    李西朋爬过来，手机举到李西海眼前。

    丰龙股份开盘就是小跌状态。

    -0.12%。

    李西海知道，这不过是试探一手而已，很快就会翻红。

    今天一天都是微红走势。

    昨天关了一下门，今天再给你一点甜头，让你离场。

    这就是主力洗盘吓唬人的手段。

    像李西雄这种顽固，暴跌、连续跌停都不走，反而补仓的。

    主力基本上都不管了。

    “诶，又涨回来了。”

    “小吃一个点。”

    李西朋不无惊喜的说道：“一个点就是一千块是吧？”

    “第一次炒股就赚了。”

    两个技师在旁边听着，但都没吭声，做着自己的事情。

    “行了，别大惊小怪的。”

    “我再睡会儿。”

    “刚子真不是个东西。”

    ……

    时间一天天过去。

    五一长假到来。

    李西海跟老爸一起回了乡下。

    这次回来的人不少，摆了二十多桌。

    李西海也跟兄弟姐妹扎堆聊着，不时的问他投资的事情。

    他都随便敷衍过去。
content_en:
Is drinking porridge.

    Li Xipeng woke up.

    "Brother, you really managed to hold on to your drinking capacity last night."

    "Niu pen."

    Li Xipeng said: "Brother Gang is really good at drinking."

    "Brother Guan and Brother Luo were both drunk and vomited."

    "You're still holding strong and haven't vomited."

    "Give me some porridge."

    Her technician went to order something. Li Xipeng lay on the bed, threw a cigarette to Li Xihai, and lit it himself out of habit.

    Before I drank the porridge, I lit a cigarette first.

    "How the hell do I know why Gangzi is crazy?"

    "He thought they were all just like him."

    Li Xihai was also helpless.

    "Hehe."

    Li Xipeng smiled, but suddenly his smile disappeared. He sat up straight, held up his mobile phone, and shouted, "Brother, I fell."

    "Fenglong fell."

    Li Xihai drank the porridge calmly and said, "If it falls, it falls. Why panic?"

    Li Xipeng crawled over and raised his phone in front of Li Xihai's eyes.

    Fenglong shares fell slightly at the opening.

    -0.12%.

    Li Xihai knew that this was just a test, and he would soon become famous.

    The trend is slightly red all day today.

    The door was closed yesterday, and today I will give you a little sweetness to let you leave.

    This is the main force's method of washing dishes to scare people.

    People like Li Xixiong are so stubborn that they don't move even after plummeting or hitting the limit continuously, but instead cover their positions.

    The main force basically doesn't care.

    "Hey, it's back up again."

    "Have a snack."

    Li Xipeng said with surprise: "One point is one thousand yuan, right?"

    "I made money the first time I traded stocks."

    The two technicians were listening, but they didn't say anything, just doing their own thing.

    "Okay, don't make a fuss."

    "I'll sleep a little longer."

    "Gangzi is really nothing."

    …

    Time passes day by day.

    The May Day holiday is coming.

    Li Xihai returned to the countryside with his father.

    A lot of people came back this time, and more than twenty tables were set up.

    Li Xihai also chatted with his brothers and sisters, asking him about investments from time to time.

    He just brushed it off casually.
